0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Utah Jazz travel to face the Memphis Grizzlies. Utah will be without Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps), and Trey Alexander (knee), while Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (ankle). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and their most recent meeting, on April 10, 2026 in Salt Lake City, went to the Jazz, 147-101.
